decisions.statement: One page is handed in here, and every file beside that page is answered for.
The page type a page moves to is named by the path of that page type's page.
Every file beside a page whose name carries the old page type states the new one instead.
A file whose name a property fixes is left where that file is.
The modules restating an address, a page type and a body's names are called rather than reached.
The body's page type and the type it satisfies are restated in the same answer.
A body naming a path that moved is repointed in the same answer.
A file beside the page is read for holding a body rather than for holding text.
An address the page type moves is restated wherever a body spells that address.
An address is restated before any file the page keeps beside it is carried.
The body states its new page type before any file beside that body is carried.
The file moved is moved by the rung this change reaches.
Nothing here changes the slug a page states.
Nothing here reads an argument off the command line.

definition: one page stated as another page type, in the data and in every file name
